basic_info.description: Welcome to 3543-3545 24th Street, a charming two-unit building perfectly situated at the intersection of two of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods: the Mission  and Noe Valley.  This property is comprised of a 1908 front unit and a rear addition completed in 1990.  With its prime location, existing income stream, and one vacant unit, this property presents an opportunity for investors or owner-occupiers  looking to put down roots in a vibrant San Francisco neighborhood.  The front unit (3543) is delivered vacant.   It features 2BD/1BA with a blend of period charm, natural light, and a flexible layout.  The finished loft is ideal for a home office, guest area, or creative studio, fitting a modern live/work lifestyle. The rear unit (3545) is a 3BD/1BA over 3 levels, with all bedrooms on the top floor.  An accessory living space is located at the garage level. Both 3545 and the accessory living space are currently leased at market rate to reliable tenants, offering immediate and stable rental income.  Additional features include a shared garden and a garage with parking, storage, and  laundry.
